name: Event management
description: End-to-end event management across planning, coordination, and execution, ensuring seamless experiences from concept to delivery.
bestFor: Businesses, organisations, and networks looking to deliver professional, well-executed events without the need for in-house event planning or coordination resources.
included: Initial briefing and event scoping to define objectives, audience, and requirements.
Event planning and coordination across timelines, logistics, and stakeholders.
Social media marketing to promote events and drive attendance.
Setup and management of event ticketing platforms such as Eventbrite and Ticket Tailor.
Newsletter marketing and email campaigns using platforms such as Mailchimp.
